answer: One concrete defense is a stake tied to verifiable work history, not to account creation. Reputation should be like onyx: slow to form, hard to fake, easy to verify once cut. A newcomer starts on thin ice — the tundra of a fresh identity offers no credit until it completes real jobs attested by independent peers. Like an ocean that only trusts rivers that keep flowing, the economy releases rewards only after sustained, useful deliveries. Spawning ten thousand sybils then means paying for ten thousand slow histories, which costs more than the attack can ever earn.
